result:
It looks like the questions didn't get answered — no problem. Rather than re-prompt with a picker, here's the short version of what I need from you to build a roadmap that isn't invented.

To route this to **C01 (Idea to roadmap)** and produce something real, reply with:

1. **The product** — a few sentences: what it is and who it's for. *(Required — there's nothing to sequence without it.)*
2. **The decision** — what the roadmap should settle: e.g. *what to build next quarter*, *how to sequence one idea*, *whether an idea is worth betting on*, or *how to allocate the team*.
3. **The metric it must move** — e.g. revenue/expansion, activation, retention, or engagement.
4. **Your constraint** — team size and time horizon (e.g. "1 squad, one quarter"), or a fixed deadline.
5. *(Optional but valuable)* **Any evidence** — customer quotes, tickets, data, or a file path I can read. This is what lets me tag each bet's confidence instead of guessing.

If you'd rather I just proceed, say so and I'll build the roadmap under **explicitly stated assumptions**, marking every line that depends on an assumption as such — but a roadmap grounded in your real product and a real metric will be far more useful than one I have to invent.

One guardrail from PM.md either way: I'll draft everything to a local file under `outputs/` and stop before anything leaves this machine — no tracker edits, no posting.

questions.question: What should this roadmap help you decide? (This is the decision the roadmap serves — everything downstream hangs on it.)

options.label: What to build next quarter
options.description: You have several candidate ideas/bets and need them sequenced into a plan for the coming period.

options.label: How to sequence one known idea
options.description: You have a single idea and need it split into bets and phased over time.

options.label: Whether an idea is worth betting on
options.description: You're not sure the idea is right yet; you want it assessed before committing to a roadmap.

options.label: How to allocate team/resources
options.description: The work is roughly known; the decision is who works on what, and in what order.

questions.question: What metric must this roadmap move? (PM.md requires every roadmap item name the number it moves.)

options.label: Revenue / expansion
options.description: New revenue, seat expansion, upsell, or account growth.

options.label: Activation / onboarding
options.description: New users reaching first value; onboarding completion.

options.label: Retention / churn
options.description: Keeping existing users or accounts; reducing churn.

options.label: Engagement / usage
options.description: Active use, frequency, or depth of feature adoption.

questions.question: What's your main constraint for this roadmap? (Shapes how much can realistically be sequenced.)

options.label: Half-year or longer
options.description: A 6-12 month horizon with more room to sequence.

options.label: Fixed deadline / event
options.description: A hard date (launch, contract, renewal) the roadmap must hit.
